title: "00_clean_data"

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data")
output_folder <- file.path(data_path, "cleaned_data")
dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

LEFT <- read.csv(file.path(data_path, "hearing_test", "LEFT_ht.csv")) %>%
  mutate(id = lag(id)) %>%
  filter(!(id == "")) %>%
  tibble()

RIGHT <- read.csv(file.path(data_path, "hearing_test", "RIGHT_ht.csv")) %>%
  mutate(id = lag(id)) %>%
  filter(!(id == "")) %>%
  tibble()


otree <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "all_apps_wide_2022-10-06.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
rt <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "rt.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
roundwise <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "roundwise.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
matrix_info <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "matrix_as_numbers.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
second_to_second <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "second_to_second.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)



excluded_ids <- c("CONCISE SEPIA QUETZAL", "TRANQUIL ORANGE FROG", "WISE MAUVE AXOLOTL", "SUPERIOR OLIVE SHRIMP")
# SUPERIOR OLIVE SHRIMP was excluded as he was 78 years old and the only parent
#The others were excluded as they seemed to have misunderstood the task
#NOT EXCLUDE: exclude_ids_age <- c( "SALUTARY JASPER TERMITE", "DELICATE TOPAZ MAGPIE")
```

## Clean hearing data
```{r}
participant_lookup <- otree %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  select(
    id = survey_followup.1.player.dyad_name,
    participant.code,
    session.code,
    gender = survey_followup.1.player.gender,
    position = survey_followup.1.player.position,
    setup = survey_followup.1.player.setup,
    age = survey_followup.1.player.age
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), id != "") %>%
  mutate(
    setup = ifelse(id == "CRISP EBONY HAMMERHEAD SHARK", "COOP", setup),
    id = case_when(
      participant.code == "ii4sef5x" ~ "PROPER ONYXS MANDRILL",
      participant.code == "1ii8knxv" ~ "MIGHTY RUBY SPIDER",
      participant.code == "hh1tewfk" ~ "PEPPY INDIGO HEDGEHOG",
      participant.code == "m5cjghle" ~ "EAGER OLIVE WOLVERINE",
      session.code == "1uyz49kz" ~ "FRESH OLIVE JACK RUSSEL",
      participant.code == "9m2nmlpj" ~ "KEEN BLACK CHINCHILLA",
      participant.code == "zonxc045" ~ "EARNEST LAVA MEERKAT",
      participant.code == "hifbo46i" ~ "LUCID JASPER BUMBLE BEE",
      participant.code == "974dg3rd" ~ "SKILLED GREEN PUG",
      TRUE ~ id
    ),
    age = parse_number(age)
  )

hearing_trials_clean <- LEFT %>%
  mutate(position = "Left") %>%
  bind_rows(
    RIGHT %>%
      mutate(position = "Right")
  ) %>%
  separate(stimulus, into = c("freq_Hz", "ear"), sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(
    freq_Hz = parse_number(freq_Hz),
    ear = toupper(ear)) %>%
  select(-any_of("X")) %>%
  arrange(id, position, ear, freq_Hz) %>%
  inner_join(
    participant_lookup %>%
      select(id, participant.code, session.code, position, gender, setup, age),
    by = c("id", "position")
  ) %>%
  relocate(start, id, participant.code, session.code, setup, position, gender, age, ear, freq_Hz, startSequence, response, RT) %>%
  mutate(
    excluded = id %in% excluded_ids
  )

# timing structure from original script
stimulus_timing <- hearing_trials_clean %>%
  select(ear, freq_Hz) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(ear, freq_Hz) %>%
  mutate(
    delay = c(230, 190, 110, 125, 135, 63,
              200, 205, 95, 95, 73, 125),
    duration = rep(c(250, rep(100, 5)), 2),
    n_beep = rep(c(12, rep(14, 5)), 2)
  )

amplitude_lookup <- tibble(
  threshold = seq(1, 14, 1),
  amplitude = seq(-39, 0, 3)
)

hearing_trials_clean <- hearing_trials_clean %>%
  left_join(stimulus_timing, by = c("ear", "freq_Hz")) %>%
  mutate(
    normalised_RT = 1 + ((RT - delay) / (duration + 1000)),
    threshold = floor(normalised_RT),
    threshold = ifelse(freq_Hz == 200, threshold + 2, threshold),
    threshold = ifelse(response == "none", NA, threshold),
    threshold = ifelse(threshold > 14, 14, threshold),
    threshold = ifelse(threshold < 1, 1, threshold)
  ) %>%
  left_join(amplitude_lookup, by = "threshold")

write_csv(hearing_trials_clean, file.path(output_folder, "hearing_trials_clean.csv"))

hearing_clean <- hearing_trials_clean %>%
  group_by(id, participant.code, session.code, setup, gender, position, age) %>%
  summarise(
    n_trials = n(),
    n_missing_threshold = sum(is.na(threshold)),
    mean_threshold = mean(threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_threshold = sd(threshold, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_amplitude = mean(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    threshold_left_ear = mean(threshold[ear == "LEFT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    threshold_right_ear = mean(threshold[ear == "RIGHT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    amplitude_left_ear = mean(amplitude[ear == "LEFT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    amplitude_right_ear = mean(amplitude[ear == "RIGHT"], na.rm = TRUE),
    excluded = first(excluded),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(
        mean_threshold, sd_threshold, mean_amplitude,
        threshold_left_ear, threshold_right_ear,
        amplitude_left_ear, amplitude_right_ear
      ),
      ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, position)

write_csv(hearing_clean, file.path(output_folder, "hearing_clean.csv"))
```


## demographics dataset
```{r}
demographics <- otree %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  select(contains("survey_followup."), participant.code, session.code) %>%
  select(!contains("survey_followup.1.player.q")) %>%
  rename(
    gender = survey_followup.1.player.gender,
    id = survey_followup.1.player.dyad_name,
    position = survey_followup.1.player.position
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("survey")) %>%
  separate(col = name, into = c("task", "dump", "round", "player", "variable")) %>%
  select(-c(dump, player, task, round)) %>%
  filter(variable != "id") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(role, payoff, age, language, parent, experience, regular, setup, round)) %>%
  select(-c(round, payoff, role)) %>%
  mutate(
    setup = ifelse(id == "CRISP EBONY HAMMERHEAD SHARK", "COOP", setup),
    id = case_when(
      participant.code == "ii4sef5x" ~ "PROPER ONYXS MANDRILL",
      participant.code == "1ii8knxv" ~ "MIGHTY RUBY SPIDER",
      participant.code == "hh1tewfk" ~ "PEPPY INDIGO HEDGEHOG",
      participant.code == "m5cjghle" ~ "EAGER OLIVE WOLVERINE",
      session.code == "1uyz49kz" ~ "FRESH OLIVE JACK RUSSEL",
      participant.code == "9m2nmlpj" ~ "KEEN BLACK CHINCHILLA",
      participant.code == "zonxc045" ~ "EARNEST LAVA MEERKAT",
      participant.code == "hifbo46i" ~ "LUCID JASPER BUMBLE BEE",
      participant.code == "974dg3rd" ~ "SKILLED GREEN PUG",
      TRUE ~ id
    ),
    age = parse_number(age)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    hearing_clean %>%
      select(
        id, participant.code, position,
        n_trials, n_missing_threshold,
        mean_threshold, sd_threshold, mean_amplitude,
        threshold_left_ear, threshold_right_ear,
        amplitude_left_ear, amplitude_right_ear
      ),
    by = c("id", "participant.code", "position")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    excluded = id %in% excluded_ids
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(id, position)

valid_participants <- participant_lookup %>%
  select(participant.code) %>%
  distinct()

demographics <- demographics %>%
  semi_join(valid_participants, by = "participant.code") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(id, position)

write_csv(demographics, file.path(output_folder, "demographics.csv"))
```

## Dyad mapping dataset
```{r}
dyad_info <- demographics %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  mutate(position = factor(position, levels = c("Left", "Right"))) %>%
  select(
    id, participant.code, gender, position, age,
    excluded
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = position,
    values_from = c(participant.code, gender, age, excluded),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    valid_mixed_gender_dyad = gender_Left != gender_Right,
    excluded_dyad = coalesce(excluded_Left, FALSE) | coalesce(excluded_Right, FALSE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(id)

write_csv(dyad_info, file.path(output_folder, "dyad_info.csv"))
```


## Sound event dataset (contains more information than gender_buttonpress.csv)
```{r}
clean_rt <- rt %>%
  rename(setup = type) %>% 
  select(-any_of(c("soundLevel", "volume", "...12"))) %>%
  separate(startSequence, into = c("date_seq", "time_seq"), sep = " ") %>%
  separate(start, into = c("date_start", "time_start"), sep = " ") %>%
  separate(end, into = c("date_end", "time_end"), sep = " ") %>%
  mutate(
    start_dt = dmy_hms(paste(date_start, time_start)),
    end_dt = dmy_hms(paste(date_end, time_end)),
    sound_start_dt = dmy_hms(paste(date_seq, time_seq)),
    response_key = case_when(
      response %in% c("CapsLock", "LeftShift") ~ "Tab",
      TRUE ~ response
    ),
    press_side = case_when(
      response_key == "Tab" ~ "Left",
      response_key == "Return" ~ "Right",
      response_key == "none" ~ "none",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sound_end_dt = if_else(
      RT == 0,
      sound_start_dt + seconds(125),
      sound_start_dt + milliseconds(RT)
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(sound_start_dt, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sound_event_order = row_number(),
    std_time = as.double(difftime(sound_start_dt, start_dt, units = "secs")),
    std_stop = as.double(difftime(sound_end_dt, start_dt, units = "secs")),
    pressed = as.integer(response_key != "none"),
    no_press = as.integer(response_key == "none")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

position_gender_lookup <- demographics %>%
  select(id, participant.code, gender, position) %>%
  distinct()

sound_events <- clean_rt %>%
  left_join(
    position_gender_lookup,
    by = c("id", "press_side" = "position")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    responder_participant_code = participant.code,
    responder_gender = gender
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    responder_gender = if_else(response_key == "none", "none", responder_gender),
    woman_pressed = case_when(
      responder_gender == "Female" ~ 1,
      responder_gender == "Male" ~ 0,
      responder_gender == "none" ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    id, setup, stimulus, sound_event_order,
    start_dt, end_dt, sound_start_dt, sound_end_dt,
    response_key, press_side, responder_participant_code, responder_gender,
    RT, std_time, std_stop, pressed, no_press, woman_pressed
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, sound_event_order)

write_csv(sound_events, file.path(output_folder, "sound_events.csv"))

gender_buttonpress_clean <- sound_events %>%
  transmute(
    setup,
    id,
    stimulus,
    response = responder_gender,
    RT,
    std_time,
    std_stop
  )

write_csv(gender_buttonpress_clean, file.path(output_folder, "gender_buttonpress.csv"))
```


## participant roundwise dataset
```{r}
roundwise_base <- roundwise %>%
  rename(setup = type) %>%
  left_join(
    demographics %>%
      select(id, participant.code, gender, position) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("id", "participant.code", "gender")
  )

max_sound_keep <- 3

roundwise_unique <- roundwise_base %>%
  group_by(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round) %>%
  summarise(
    secs = first(secs),
    matrix = first(matrix),
    correct = first(correct),
    completed = first(completed),
    answer = first(answer),
    success = first(success),
    stimulus_labels_round = paste(unique(stimulus[!is.na(stimulus)]), collapse = " | "),
    any_stimulus = any(!is.na(stimulus)),
    n_rows_collapsed = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sts_round <- second_to_second %>%
  rename(setup = type) %>%
  group_by(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round) %>%
  arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sec_in_round = row_number() - 1,
    sound_on = s_on == 1,
    new_episode = sound_on & !lag(sound_on, default = FALSE),
    episode = cumsum(new_episode)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

round_sound_episodes <- sts_round %>%
  filter(sound_on) %>%
  group_by(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round, episode) %>%
  summarise(
    start_sec = min(sec_in_round),
    end_sec = max(sec_in_round) + 1,
    duration = end_sec - start_sec,
    stimulus = paste(unique(stimulus[!is.na(stimulus)]), collapse = " | "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(setup, id, participant.code, round, episode)

round_exposure <- sts_round %>%
  group_by(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round) %>%
  summarise(
    secs_total = n(),
    secs_sound = sum(sound_on, na.rm = TRUE),
    sound_prop = mean(sound_on, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sound_episodes = sum(sound_on & !lag(sound_on, default = FALSE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

round_sound_episodes_wide <- round_sound_episodes %>%
  filter(episode <= max_sound_keep) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round),
    names_from = episode,
    values_from = c(start_sec, end_sec, duration, stimulus),
    names_glue = "sound{episode}_{.value}"
  )

# assign each sound event to participant-round using the second in which the sound starts
sound_event_round_map <- sound_events %>%
  mutate(event_time_sec = floor(std_time)) %>%
  left_join(
    second_to_second %>%
      rename(setup = type) %>%
      select(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, time, round) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("setup", "id", "event_time_sec" = "time")
  ) %>%
  rename(sound_event_in_round = round) %>%
  left_join(
    sts_round %>%
      select(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round, time, sec_in_round) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("setup", "id", "participant.code", "gender", "position",
           "sound_event_in_round" = "round", "event_time_sec" = "time")
  ) %>%
  rename(sound_start_sec_in_round = sec_in_round) %>%
  mutate(
    button_press_sec_in_round = if_else(
      pressed == 1,
      sound_start_sec_in_round + RT / 1000,
      NA_real_
    ),
    pressed_by = case_when(
      pressed == 0 ~ "none",
      responder_participant_code == participant.code ~ "participant",
      !is.na(responder_participant_code) & responder_participant_code != participant.code ~ "partner",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

round_button_summary <- sound_event_round_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(sound_event_in_round)) %>%
  group_by(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round = sound_event_in_round) %>%
  summarise(
    any_button_press = any(pressed == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_button_press_events = sum(pressed == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_button_press_sec = suppressWarnings(min(button_press_sec_in_round, na.rm = TRUE)),
    last_button_press_sec = suppressWarnings(max(button_press_sec_in_round, na.rm = TRUE)),
    participant_pressed_in_round = any(pressed_by == "participant", na.rm = TRUE),
    partner_pressed_in_round = any(pressed_by == "partner", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_participant_press_events = sum(pressed_by == "participant", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_partner_press_events = sum(pressed_by == "partner", na.rm = TRUE),
    first_button_press_by = pressed_by[which.min(if_else(is.na(button_press_sec_in_round), Inf, button_press_sec_in_round))],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    first_button_press_sec = ifelse(is.infinite(first_button_press_sec), NA, first_button_press_sec),
    last_button_press_sec = ifelse(is.infinite(last_button_press_sec), NA, last_button_press_sec),
    any_button_press = as.integer(any_button_press),
    participant_pressed_in_round = as.integer(participant_pressed_in_round),
    partner_pressed_in_round = as.integer(partner_pressed_in_round),
    first_button_press_by = ifelse(n_button_press_events == 0, "none", first_button_press_by)
  )

round_button_events_wide <- sound_event_round_map %>%
  filter(!is.na(sound_event_in_round)) %>%
  group_by(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round = sound_event_in_round) %>%
  arrange(sound_start_sec_in_round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(sound_event_number_in_round = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(sound_event_number_in_round <= max_sound_keep) %>%
  transmute(
    setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round,
    sound_event_number_in_round,
    sound_start_sec_in_round,
    button_press_sec_in_round,
    pressed,
    pressed_by,
    responder_gender,
    responder_participant_code
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(setup, id, participant.code, gender, position, round),
    names_from = sound_event_number_in_round,
    values_from = c(
      sound_start_sec_in_round,
      button_press_sec_in_round,
      pressed,
      pressed_by,
      responder_gender,
      responder_participant_code
    ),
    names_glue = "sound{sound_event_number_in_round}_{.value}"
  )

roundwise_clean <- roundwise_unique %>%
  left_join(
    round_exposure,
    by = c("setup", "id", "participant.code", "gender", "position", "round")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    round_sound_episodes_wide,
    by = c("setup", "id", "participant.code", "gender", "position", "round")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    round_button_summary,
    by = c("setup", "id", "participant.code", "gender", "position", "round")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    round_button_events_wide,
    by = c("setup", "id", "participant.code", "gender", "position", "round")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    demographics %>%
      select(
        id, participant.code, session.code, gender, position, age,
        language, parent, experience, regular,
        n_trials, n_missing_threshold,
        mean_threshold, sd_threshold, mean_amplitude,
        threshold_left_ear, threshold_right_ear,
        amplitude_left_ear, amplitude_right_ear,
        excluded
      ),
    by = c("id", "participant.code", "gender", "position")
  ) %>%
  arrange(setup, id, participant.code, round)

write_csv(roundwise_clean, file.path(output_folder, "roundwise_clean.csv"))
```

## GES data

```{r}
## GES data
otree[] <- lapply(otree, as.character)

ges_long <- otree %>%
  select(
    contains("survey_followup.1.player.q"),
    survey_followup.1.player.setup,
    participant.code,
    session.code,
    survey_followup.1.player.gender,
    survey_followup.1.player.dyad_name,
    survey_followup.1.player.position
  ) %>%
  rename(
    gender = survey_followup.1.player.gender,
    id = survey_followup.1.player.dyad_name,
    position = survey_followup.1.player.position,
    setup = survey_followup.1.player.setup
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = contains("survey_followup.1.player.q")) %>%
  separate(name, into = c("task", "dump", "round", "player", "variable")) %>%
  select(-dump, -player, -task, -round) %>%
  mutate(
    value = parse_number(value),
    value = ifelse(variable %in% c("q4", "q9", "q15", "q16", "q25"), -value, value),
    setup = if_else(id == "CRISP EBONY HAMMERHEAD SHARK", "COOP", setup),
    id = case_when(
      participant.code == "ii4sef5x" ~ "PROPER ONYXS MANDRILL",
      participant.code == "1ii8knxv" ~ "MIGHTY RUBY SPIDER",
      participant.code == "hh1tewfk" ~ "PEPPY INDIGO HEDGEHOG",
      participant.code == "m5cjghle" ~ "EAGER OLIVE WOLVERINE",
      session.code == "1uyz49kz" ~ "FRESH OLIVE JACK RUSSEL",
      participant.code == "9m2nmlpj" ~ "KEEN BLACK CHINCHILLA",
      participant.code == "zonxc045" ~ "EARNEST LAVA MEERKAT",
      participant.code == "hifbo46i" ~ "LUCID JASPER BUMBLE BEE",
      participant.code == "974dg3rd" ~ "SKILLED GREEN PUG",
      TRUE ~ id
    )
  )

ges_long_clean <- ges_long %>%
  inner_join(
    demographics %>%
      select(id, participant.code, session.code, gender, position, setup, excluded),
    by = c("id", "participant.code", "session.code", "gender", "position", "setup")
  ) %>%
  arrange(setup, id, participant.code, variable)

ges_summary <- ges_long_clean %>%
  group_by(id, participant.code, session.code, setup, gender, position) %>%
  summarise(
    ges_sum = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    ges_score = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    ges_sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ges_items = sum(!is.na(value)),
    excluded = first(excluded),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(setup, id, position)

write_csv(ges_long_clean, file.path(output_folder, "ges_long_clean.csv"))
write_csv(ges_summary, file.path(output_folder, "ges_summary.csv"))
```

## Prisoner dilemma data 

```{r}
prisoner_df <- otree %>%
  select(
    survey_followup.1.player.setup,
    participant.code,
    session.code,
    survey_followup.1.player.gender,
    survey_followup.1.player.dyad_name,
    survey_followup.1.player.position,
    age = survey_followup.1.player.age,
    contains("prisoner"),
    -contains("role"),
    -contains("payoff"),
    -contains("id_in_subsession")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    gender = survey_followup.1.player.gender,
    id = survey_followup.1.player.dyad_name,
    position = survey_followup.1.player.position,
    setup = survey_followup.1.player.setup
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), id != "") %>%
  mutate(
    setup = ifelse(id == "CRISP EBONY HAMMERHEAD SHARK", "COOP", setup),
    id = case_when(
      participant.code == "ii4sef5x" ~ "PROPER ONYXS MANDRILL",
      participant.code == "1ii8knxv" ~ "MIGHTY RUBY SPIDER",
      participant.code == "hh1tewfk" ~ "PEPPY INDIGO HEDGEHOG",
      participant.code == "m5cjghle" ~ "EAGER OLIVE WOLVERINE",
      session.code == "1uyz49kz" ~ "FRESH OLIVE JACK RUSSEL",
      participant.code == "9m2nmlpj" ~ "KEEN BLACK CHINCHILLA",
      participant.code == "zonxc045" ~ "EARNEST LAVA MEERKAT",
      participant.code == "hifbo46i" ~ "LUCID JASPER BUMBLE BEE",
      participant.code == "974dg3rd" ~ "SKILLED GREEN PUG",
      TRUE ~ id
    )) %>% 
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>% 
  filter(!id %in% excluded_ids)

prisoner_long <- prisoner_df %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("prisoner."),
               names_to = c("round_from_column", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "^prisoner\\.(\\d+)\\.(?:player|subsession)\\.(.+)$",
               names_transform = list(round_from_column = as.integer)) %>% 
  mutate(round_number = as.integer(round_number)) %>% 
  select(setup, participant.code, session.code, gender, id, position, age, 
         round_number, id_in_group, decision, pay_off) %>% 
  arrange(id, participant.code, round_number)

write_csv(prisoner_long, file.path(output_folder, "prisoner_dilemma_clean.csv"))
```
